card.name: Linking words before immunoglobulin or ULN
card.fires_on: The word "with" after "measles, prophylaxis" in corticosteroid infection warnings, and "times" in "three or more times the upper limit of normal" in liver enzyme warnings.

modes.label: Measles prophylaxis
modes.description: The word "with" right after "prophylaxis" when immunoglobulin is about to be named after measles exposure.
modes.example: If a dexamethasone-treated patient is exposed to measles, prophylaxis<< with>> immunoglobulin may be indicated.
